backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Gojri poetry platform, managing poems, collections, user profiles, and notifications with role-based access control (admin/user) and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking the admin password update feature (to 'SC05GOJRI') to the useAdminAuth hook file and associated components/test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key details of each component, page, hook, and utility in the React app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, etc.) using OKLCH values.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that sets the page title to 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab' and mounts the React app via the root div and main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with routes for home, poem detail, admin form, admin panel, and collections, wrapped in ThemeProvider and QueryClientProvider.
Modal dialog component for admin password login, using the useAdminAuth hook to validate the password and displaying inline error messages on failure.
Route guard component that renders children only when the user is in admin mode, otherwise showing an access-denied message with navigation buttons.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: App layout component with a sticky header containing the site brand, conditional admin navigation links, admin badge/logout button, and an AdminLoginModal trigger.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Renders a login/logout button using Internet Identity authentication, handling login, logout, and loading states with appropriate icons.
frontend/src/components/NotificationBell: Displays a bell icon button with an unread notification count badge that opens a NotificationPanel popover on click.
frontend/src/components/NotificationPane: Shows a scrollable list of user notifications with timestamps and a button to mark individual notifications as read.
frontend/src/components/PoemCard.tsx: Renders a poem card with support for image or text poems, collection badges, add-to-collection dialog, and admin delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/UserProfileSetup: Displays a modal dialog prompting newly authenticated users to enter their name to complete profile setup.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: Manages admin session state via sessionStorage with a hardcoded password, exposing login and logout functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login, logout, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting poems, collections, notifications, and user profiles.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts (Crimson Text, Lora, Inter), sets up Tailwind directives, and defines CSS custom properties for a warm earth-tone color palette in both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider (React Query) and InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminForm.tsx: Admin page form for submitting new poems, supporting both text and image poem types, collection assignment, and image upload with progress tracking, guarded by AdminRouteGuard.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page that displays the current draft/live status of the app and provides a confirmation dialog to publish the app to production.
frontend/src/pages/CollectionManager.tsx: Admin page for managing poem collections, allowing creation and deletion of collections and removal of individual poems from collections, guarded by AdminRouteGuard.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page that displays all poems with debounced search, collection filtering, and a loading state, rendering poems in a card grid layout.
frontend/src/pages/PoemDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single poem that shows its content or image, supports adding to collections, downloading as image, and admin-only delete/edit actions.
frontend/src/utils/downloadHelpers.ts: Provides utility functions to download images from a URL or Blob via a temporary anchor element, and a helper to sanitize filenames by replacing non-alphanumeric characters with underscores.
frontend/src/utils/formatDate.ts: Exports a single function that converts a nanosecond-precision `Time` value to a human-readable 'Month Day, Year' date string using the en-US locale.
frontend/src/utils/poemImageGenerator.ts: Renders a `Poem` object onto an HTML Canvas (1200×1600) with styled title, content, author, and branding, then returns the result as a PNG Blob.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routes, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive parameters from the URL hash without a page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that extends the default theme with oklch-based design tokens, custom fonts (Inter, Crimson Text, Lora), border radii, shadows, and accordion animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins enabled.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata and feature history for the 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab' app, noting the admin login password is set to SC05GOJRI.
